connector.name: AgentPhone
connector.registryDescription: Give AI agents real phone numbers, messages, and voice calls via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.agentphone.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package agentphone-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the agentphone-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for AgentPhone API authentication (format: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY). Get your key at https://agentphone.ai

env.name: AGENTPHONE_API_KEY
env.description: Your AgentPhone API key. Get one at https://agentphone.ai
